+

+

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+from io import BytesIO
+import importlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import socket
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from zipfile import ZipFile
+
+import pytest
+
+import cartopy
+from cartopy.io import Downloader
+import cartopy.io.shapereader as shapereader
+
+
+NE_KEY = ("shapefiles", "natural_earth")
+RUNTIME_DATA = Path("/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/runtime-data")
+RUNTIME_PREEXISTING = Path(
+    "/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/runtime-preexisting"
+)
+
+COASTLINE_REL = (
+    "shapefiles/natural_earth/physical/ne_110m_coastline.shp"
+)
+RIVERS_REL = (
+    "shapefiles/natural_earth/physical/"
+    "ne_110m_rivers_lake_centerlines.shp"
+)
+ADMIN_REL = (
+    "shapefiles/natural_earth/cultural/ne_50m_admin_0_countries.shp"
+)
+
+COASTLINE_FMT = {
+    "config": cartopy.config,
+    "resolution": "110m",
+    "category": "physical",
+    "name": "coastline",
+}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def restore_cartopy_config():
+    original_data_dir = cartopy.config["data_dir"]
+    original_pre_existing_data_dir = cartopy.config["pre_existing_data_dir"]
+    original_downloaders = dict(cartopy.config["downloaders"])
+    yield
+    cartopy.config["data_dir"] = original_data_dir
+    cartopy.config["pre_existing_data_dir"] = original_pre_existing_data_dir
+    cartopy.config["downloaders"].clear()
+    cartopy.config["downloaders"].update(original_downloaders)
+    for path in (
+        RUNTIME_DATA,
+        RUNTIME_PREEXISTING,
+        Path("/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/acquire-full"),
+        Path("/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/acquire-optional"),
+        Path("/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/acquire-missing"),
+        Path("/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/side-effect-target"),
+    ):
+        shutil.rmtree(path, ignore_errors=True)
+
+
+class _ZipResponse:
+    def __init__(self, data: bytes):
+        self._data = data
+        self.closed = False
+
+    def read(self) -> bytes:
+        return self._data
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self.closed = True
+
+
+def _use_runtime_natural_earth_config() -> None:
+    shutil.rmtree(RUNTIME_DATA, ignore_errors=True)
+    shutil.rmtree(RUNTIME_PREEXISTING, ignore_errors=True)
+    cartopy.config["data_dir"] = RUNTIME_DATA
+    cartopy.config["pre_existing_data_dir"] = RUNTIME_PREEXISTING
+    cartopy.config["downloaders"][NE_KEY] = (
+        shapereader.NEShpDownloader.default_downloader()
+    )
+
+
+def _touch_runtime_resource(relative_path: str) -> None:
+    resource = RUNTIME_DATA / relative_path
+    resource.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    resource.write_text("existing shapefile sentinel", encoding="ascii")
+
+
+def _zip_bytes(members: dict[str, bytes]) -> bytes:
+    buffer = BytesIO()
+    with ZipFile(buffer, "w") as zip_file:
+        for name, payload in members.items():
+            zip_file.writestr(name, payload)
+    return buffer.getvalue()
+
+
+def _coastline_members() -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    return {
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shp": b"shape-bytes",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.dbf": b"dbf-bytes",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shx": b"shx-bytes",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.prj": b"prj-bytes",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.cpg": b"cpg-bytes",
+    }
+
+
+def test_natural_earth_default_targets_110m_physical_coastline():
+
+
+
+
+    _use_runtime_natural_earth_config()
+    _touch_runtime_resource(COASTLINE_REL)
+
+    actual = shapereader.natural_earth()
+
+    assert actual == Path(
+        "/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/runtime-data/"
+        "shapefiles/natural_earth/physical/ne_110m_coastline.shp"
+    )
+
+
+def test_natural_earth_rivers_targets_110m_physical_rivers():
+
+
+
+
+    _use_runtime_natural_earth_config()
+    _touch_runtime_resource(RIVERS_REL)
+
+    actual = shapereader.natural_earth(
+        resolution="110m",
+        category="physical",
+        name="rivers_lake_centerlines",
+    )
+
+    assert actual == Path(
+        "/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/runtime-data/"
+        "shapefiles/natural_earth/physical/"
+        "ne_110m_rivers_lake_centerlines.shp"
+    )
+
+
+def test_default_url_template_formats_110m_physical_coastline():
+
+
+
+
+    downloader = shapereader.NEShpDownloader.default_downloader()
+
+    actual = downloader.url(COASTLINE_FMT)
+
+    assert actual == (
+        "https://naturalearth.s3.amazonaws.com/"
+        "110m_physical/ne_110m_coastline.zip"
+    )
+
+
+def test_default_url_template_formats_50m_cultural_admin_countries():
+
+
+
+
+    downloader = shapereader.NEShpDownloader.default_downloader()
+    format_dict = {
+        "config": cartopy.config,
+        "resolution": "50m",
+        "category": "cultural",
+        "name": "admin_0_countries",
+    }
+
+    actual = downloader.url(format_dict)
+
+    assert actual == (
+        "https://naturalearth.s3.amazonaws.com/"
+        "50m_cultural/ne_50m_admin_0_countries.zip"
+    )
+
+
+def test_default_downloader_uses_data_and_preexisting_templates():
+
+
+
+
+    downloader = shapereader.NEShpDownloader.default_downloader()
+
+    format_dict = {
+        "config": {
+            "data_dir": RUNTIME_DATA,
+            "pre_existing_data_dir": RUNTIME_PREEXISTING,
+        },
+        "resolution": "50m",
+        "category": "cultural",
+        "name": "admin_0_countries",
+    }
+
+
+    assert downloader.target_path(format_dict) == RUNTIME_DATA / ADMIN_REL
+    assert (
+        downloader.pre_downloaded_path(format_dict)
+        == RUNTIME_PREEXISTING / ADMIN_REL
+    )
+
+
+def test_import_registers_default_downloader_when_missing():
+
+
+
+
+    cartopy.config["downloaders"].pop(NE_KEY, None)
+
+    reloaded = importlib.reload(shapereader)
+    registered = cartopy.config["downloaders"][NE_KEY]
+
+
+    assert isinstance(registered, shapereader.NEShpDownloader)
+    assert registered.url_template == (
+        "https://naturalearth.s3.amazonaws.com/"
+        "{resolution}_{category}/ne_{resolution}_{name}.zip"
+    )
+    assert reloaded is shapereader
+
+
+def test_import_does_not_overwrite_existing_custom_downloader():
+
+
+
+
+    custom = Downloader(
+        "https://example.invalid/custom/{name}.zip",
+        "/custom-data/{name}.shp",
+    )
+    cartopy.config["downloaders"][NE_KEY] = custom
+
+    importlib.reload(shapereader)
+
+    assert cartopy.config["downloaders"][NE_KEY] is custom
+
+    assert not isinstance(cartopy.config["downloaders"][NE_KEY], shapereader.NEShpDownloader)
+
+
+def test_zip_file_contents_yields_all_natural_earth_members():
+
+
+
+
+    downloader = shapereader.NEShpDownloader.default_downloader()
+
+    actual = list(downloader.zip_file_contents(COASTLINE_FMT))
+
+
+    assert sorted(actual) == sorted([
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shp",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.dbf",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shx",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.prj",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.cpg",
+    ])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "existing_category", [True, False],
+    ids=["existing-category", "missing-nested-directory"],
+)
+def test_acquire_resource_extracts_required_and_optional_members(
+    monkeypatch, tmp_path, existing_category
+):
+
+
+
+
+    target = tmp_path / COASTLINE_REL
+    if existing_category:
+        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    else:
+        assert not (tmp_path / "shapefiles").exists()
+    assert target.parent.is_dir() == existing_category
+    assert not target.exists()
+    downloader = shapereader.NEShpDownloader.default_downloader()
+    requested_urls = []
+    response = _ZipResponse(_zip_bytes(_coastline_members()))
+
+    def fake_urlopen(url):
+        requested_urls.append(url)
+        return response
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(downloader, "_urlopen", fake_urlopen)
+
+    actual = downloader.acquire_resource(target, COASTLINE_FMT)
+
+    assert actual == target
+    assert requested_urls == [
+        "https://naturalearth.s3.amazonaws.com/"
+        "110m_physical/ne_110m_coastline.zip"
+    ]
+
+    assert target.parent.is_dir()
+    assert sorted(path.name for path in target.parent.iterdir()) == [
+        "ne_110m_coastline.cpg",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.dbf",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.prj",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shp",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shx",
+    ]
+    assert (target.parent / "ne_110m_coastline.shp").read_bytes() == (
+        b"shape-bytes"
+    )
+    assert (target.parent / "ne_110m_coastline.dbf").read_bytes() == b"dbf-bytes"
+    assert (target.parent / "ne_110m_coastline.shx").read_bytes() == b"shx-bytes"
+    assert (target.parent / "ne_110m_coastline.prj").read_bytes() == b"prj-bytes"
+    assert (target.parent / "ne_110m_coastline.cpg").read_bytes() == b"cpg-bytes"
+
+
+def test_acquire_resource_allows_missing_optional_prj_and_cpg(monkeypatch):
+
+
+
+
+    target = Path(
+        "/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/acquire-optional/"
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shp"
+    )
+    members = {
+        key: value
+        for key, value in _coastline_members().items()
+        if not key.endswith((".prj", ".cpg"))
+    }
+    downloader = shapereader.NEShpDownloader.default_downloader()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        downloader,
+        "_urlopen",
+        lambda url: _ZipResponse(_zip_bytes(members)),
+    )
+
+    actual = downloader.acquire_resource(target, COASTLINE_FMT)
+
+    assert actual == Path(
+        "/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/acquire-optional/"
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shp"
+    )
+
+    assert {
+        "ne_110m_coastline.dbf",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shp",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shx",
+    }.issubset({path.name for path in target.parent.iterdir()})
+
+
+def _assert_missing_required_member_raises(missing_suffix: str):
+    target = Path(
+        "/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/acquire-missing/"
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shp"
+    )
+    members = {
+        key: value
+        for key, value in _coastline_members().items()
+        if not key.endswith(missing_suffix)
+    }
+    downloader = shapereader.NEShpDownloader.default_downloader()
+    downloader._urlopen = lambda url: _ZipResponse(_zip_bytes(members))
+
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError) as exc_info:
+        downloader.acquire_resource(target, COASTLINE_FMT)
+
+
+    assert exc_info.type is KeyError
+
+
+def test_acquire_resource_raises_keyerror_when_shp_missing():
+
+
+
+
+    _assert_missing_required_member_raises(".shp")
+
+
+def test_acquire_resource_raises_keyerror_when_dbf_missing():
+
+
+
+
+    _assert_missing_required_member_raises(".dbf")
+
+
+def test_acquire_resource_raises_keyerror_when_shx_missing():
+
+
+
+
+    _assert_missing_required_member_raises(".shx")
+
+
+def test_referential_transparency_for_existing_resource():
+    _use_runtime_natural_earth_config()
+    _touch_runtime_resource(COASTLINE_REL)
+
+    first = shapereader.natural_earth(
+        resolution="110m",
+        category="physical",
+        name="coastline",
+    )
+    second = shapereader.natural_earth(
+        resolution="110m",
+        category="physical",
+        name="coastline",
+    )
+
+    assert first == second
+    assert first == Path(
+        "/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/runtime-data/"
+        "shapefiles/natural_earth/physical/ne_110m_coastline.shp"
+    )
+
+
+def test_format_dict_is_not_mutated_by_downloader_path_formatting():
+    _use_runtime_natural_earth_config()
+    downloader = shapereader.NEShpDownloader.default_downloader()
+    format_dict = {
+        "config": {
+            "data_dir": RUNTIME_DATA,
+            "pre_existing_data_dir": RUNTIME_PREEXISTING,
+        },
+        "resolution": "110m",
+        "category": "physical",
+        "name": "coastline",
+    }
+    original = copy.deepcopy(format_dict)
+
+    actual = downloader.target_path(format_dict)
+
+    assert actual == Path(
+        "/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/runtime-data/"
+        "shapefiles/natural_earth/physical/ne_110m_coastline.shp"
+    )
+
+    assert original["name"] == actual.stem.removeprefix("ne_110m_")
+
+
+def test_no_global_state_same_input_matches_fresh_process():
+    _use_runtime_natural_earth_config()
+    _touch_runtime_resource(COASTLINE_REL)
+    in_process = str(
+        shapereader.natural_earth(
+            resolution="110m",
+            category="physical",
+            name="coastline",
+        )
+    )
+    script = """
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+import cartopy
+import cartopy.io.shapereader as shapereader
+cartopy.config['data_dir'] = Path('/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/runtime-data')
+cartopy.config['pre_existing_data_dir'] = Path('/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/runtime-preexisting')
+cartopy.config['downloaders'][('shapefiles', 'natural_earth')] = shapereader.NEShpDownloader.default_downloader()
+resource = Path('/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/runtime-data/shapefiles/natural_earth/physical/ne_110m_coastline.shp')
+resource.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+resource.write_text('existing shapefile sentinel', encoding='ascii')
+out = shapereader.natural_earth(resolution='110m', category='physical', name='coastline')
+sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(str(out)))
+"""
+
+    completed = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "-c", script],
+        check=True,
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+        text=True,
+    )
+    fresh_process = json.loads(completed.stdout)
+
+    assert in_process == (
+        "/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/runtime-data/"
+        "shapefiles/natural_earth/physical/ne_110m_coastline.shp"
+    )
+    assert fresh_process == (
+        "/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/runtime-data/"
+        "shapefiles/natural_earth/physical/ne_110m_coastline.shp"
+    )
+    assert in_process == fresh_process
+
+
+def test_no_undeclared_side_effects_outside_declared_acquire_target(
+    monkeypatch, tmp_path
+):
+    declared_target = Path(
+        "/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/side-effect-target/"
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shp"
+    )
+    shutil.rmtree(declared_target.parent, ignore_errors=True)
+    downloader = shapereader.NEShpDownloader.default_downloader()
+
+    def deny_socket(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError("unexpected network socket use")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "socket", deny_socket)
+    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        downloader,
+        "_urlopen",
+        lambda url: _ZipResponse(_zip_bytes(_coastline_members())),
+    )
+
+    actual = downloader.acquire_resource(declared_target, COASTLINE_FMT)
+
+    assert actual == Path(
+        "/workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/side-effect-target/"
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shp"
+    )
+    assert sorted(path.name for path in declared_target.parent.iterdir()) == [
+        "ne_110m_coastline.cpg",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.dbf",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.prj",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shp",
+        "ne_110m_coastline.shx",
+    ]
+
+    assert (declared_target.parent / "ne_110m_coastline.shp").exists()

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+
+
+
+
+export NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:-} --max-old-space-size=4096"
+export MAVEN_OPTS="${MAVEN_OPTS:-} -Xmx3g -XX:+UseG1GC"
+export GRADLE_OPTS="${GRADLE_OPTS:-} -Xmx3g -XX:+UseG1GC"
+export TEST_JVM_OPTS="${TEST_JVM_OPTS:-} -Xmx3g"
+set -e
+cd /workspace/repo
+set -euo pipefail
+cd /workspace/repo
+export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
+export SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION_FOR_CARTOPY="${SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION_FOR_CARTOPY:-0.0.0}"
+export PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1
+python -m pip install --no-index --no-build-isolation --no-deps -e . >/dev/null 2>&1
+exec python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -o addopts='' /workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/test_natural_earth_downloader.py -v

rationale: Instruction lines 3-7 require Natural Earth ZIP acquisition to create the target directory and extract the requested shapefile and required sidecars. The original acquisition test used only an absent, single-level directory. Parameterize that same byte-checking test over an already-existing category directory and a wholly absent shapefiles/natural_earth/physical hierarchy. Call the real NEShpDownloader.acquire_resource with only _urlopen replaced by the existing in-memory ZIP response fixture. Preserve all five exact member-byte assertions, the requested URL assertion, and normal runner inclusion; no forwarding mock substitutes for extraction. These cases are intended to reject directory creation that lacks exist_ok semantics or recursive parent creation without prescribing the implementation.
